context: Mei sews a small repair on Sho-young's favorite shirt.
purpose: Mother carefully mending child's favorite item.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Mom, can you fix my clothes?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant opening. Small boy's voice, barely above a whisper. Gentle rising hope at the end of the question — checking if it's okay to ask. Warm and trusting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yeah, I have needle and thread.
lines.style: Quick, matter-of-fact reassurance. A small smile in the voice. Warm without sentimentality — practical care delivered gently. No pause, no drama.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright burst of relief and joy. Genuine small-boy laugh underneath. Quick and uncomplicated — pure gratitude without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: It's important to you, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft, knowing statement. Not a question. Quiet tenderness — she understands why this matters. Slight pause before speaking, like she's seeing him see the shirt. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah — I can wear it again!
lines.style: Delighted, open-throated child voice. Quick tempo, bright energy. The joy of solution, not performance. Small laugh of relief woven through.
